chunks: And asked them: "What matter, O angels, brings you here?"
ai.seo_question: What did the angels ask the messengers in Surah Al-Hijr?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Hijr, the angels address the messengers (often interpreted as Jibril, Mikail, and Israfil) with the question 'What is your affair?', seeking clarification on the purpose of their divine gathering. This interaction underscores the hierarchical yet collaborative nature of the celestial court, where even high-ranking angels inquire about specific divine decrees or missions. The phrasing highlights the precision of divine communication and the readiness of the messengers to execute God's will.
